title: Never install in the engine compartment; top face upwards
body_md: The device must be installed inside the vehicle. It must never be installed in the engine compartment. Because Pro-finder contains a GPS receiver, the top of the device must face upwards.
prev_context: Before this stands the requirement on accessibility.
next_context: The requirement for an unobstructed view of the satellite follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 7: equivalent in substance, including the explicit prohibition for the engine compartment.
